# 1 Enoch Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**22:1** And from thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west another great and high mountain [and] a hard rock, and four hollow-places deep and wide and very smooth. Three [of them were] dark and one [was] bright, with a spring-of-water in its midst. And I said: "How smooth are these hollow-places, and deep and dark to look at!"

**22:2** Then Raphael, one of the holy-angels who was with me, answered and said to me: "These hollow-places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea, that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here."

**22:3** "And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgment and till their appointed period, till the great judgment [comes] upon them."

**22:4** I saw the spirit of a dead man, and his voice went forth to heaven and made supplication.

**22:5** And I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said to him: "This spirit — whose is it whose voice goes forth and makes supplication to heaven?"

**22:6** And he answered me and said to me, and I heard his voice: "This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men."

**22:7** Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow-places: "Why is one separated from another?"

**22:8** And he answered me and said to me: "These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And this division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright-spring of water."

**22:9** "And such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgment has not been executed on them in their lifetime."

**22:10** "Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgment, and punishment, and torment of those who curse for ever, and retribution for their spirits. There he shall bind them for ever."

**22:11** "And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners."

**22:12** "And such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions; but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgment nor shall they be raised from thence."

**22:13** Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said: "Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness, who ruleth for ever."

**22:14** [And from thence I went to another place to the east of that mountain, and there I saw the ends of the earth.]

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar or absent from some witnesses. Ch. 22 is the great Sheol chapter, depicting four chambers for the dead: the righteous (bright, with spring), sinners not yet judged, murder victims petitioning for justice, and sinners who will not be raised. Abel's spirit appears as the paradigmatic wronged soul. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
